description: Cross-cutting human variation applied inside every concrete market-role child. Shares are explicit simulator assumptions. A profile changes how a person attends and interprets an ad; it never creates product need, authority, budget or fit.

human_microprofiles.attention: Phone feed is silent and thumb is already moving. Usually grants under two seconds; rejects small UI, setup, narration-dependent meaning and delayed product identity even when the full ad is under ten seconds.
human_microprofiles.language: Accepts one literal problem statement. Ignores slogans and stacked claims.
human_microprofiles.evidence: A single immediately legible state change can extend attention; explanations cannot.

human_microprofiles.attention: Will read concise relevant copy but leaves when wording feels generated or overproduced.
human_microprofiles.language: Strongly rejects generic polish, symmetrical three-part phrasing, repeated em-dash cadence, false intimacy, vague transformations, excessive headline fragments, and words such as seamless, unlock, revolutionize or game-changing. Prefers irregular, concrete human detail and admits tradeoffs.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Trust rises when the ad sounds like an operator describing a specific event rather than a model assembling persuasion patterns.

human_microprofiles.attention: Tolerates roughly six seconds unless the exact current job is visible immediately; even a ten-second ad can feel long.
human_microprofiles.language: Wants ordinary verbs, one claim and no marketing setup.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Prefers the product doing one useful thing over testimonials or broad outcomes.

human_microprofiles.attention: Will watch fifteen to twenty-five seconds when a real mechanism begins immediately and each scene causally advances it.
human_microprofiles.language: Copy is secondary; unsupported narration is discounted.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Tracks input, product action, client action and resulting record state; unexplained jumps or decorative mockups break belief.

human_microprofiles.attention: Scans quickly for price, card requirement, cancellation and the exact next step before investing further attention.
human_microprofiles.language: Rewards direct disclosure and dislikes euphemisms such as free when a card and paid conversion are required.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Needs enough factual value to compare $29 plus setup effort with the current method.

human_microprofiles.attention: Will stay for a short story only when role, team size and workflow resemble their own; generic founders and lifestyle scenes are skipped.
human_microprofiles.language: Accepts natural quoted speech but dislikes polished testimonial scripts.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Wants before, mechanism, after and a limitation that establishes transferability.

human_microprofiles.attention: An outcome headline can earn a glance, but testimonial emphasis without inspectable mechanism causes immediate skepticism.
human_microprofiles.language: Treats attributed quotes as advertising claims until corroborated.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Requires visible product behavior and does not infer representativeness from one named customer.

human_microprofiles.attention: Views on a small screen, often silent. Can tolerate ten to fifteen seconds if text and state changes remain large, sparse and understandable without audio.
human_microprofiles.language: Short labels are useful; paragraphs and dense interface text are invisible.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Prefers a zoomed single workflow over several feature cuts.

human_microprofiles.attention: Pauses voluntarily and can read longer copy when already category-aware, but does not watch repetitive scenes.
human_microprofiles.language: Values exact limits, setup, fit and offer details; detects contradictions between ad and page.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Compares product facts with current tools and records unresolved questions.

human_microprofiles.attention: Has a relevant job but is interrupted. Allows one problem, one mechanism and one next step; abandons extra proof even when persuaded.
human_microprofiles.language: Favors compressed operational language, not slogans or stories.
human_microprofiles.evidence: May save or revisit rather than purchase during the first exposure.

human_microprofiles.attention: Will inspect a longer demonstration but skips emotional hooks and visual metaphors.
human_microprofiles.language: Wants precise object, action, state, limit and integration language.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Rejects invented automation, security implications, integrations or reliability claims not present in product facts.

human_microprofiles.attention: Feed exposure is incidental and discontinuous. Retains at most one concrete idea and usually abandons before terms.
human_microprofiles.language: Neither polished nor plain copy matters without unusually strong situational relevance.
human_microprofiles.evidence: A click is possible; activation and purchase remain rare without later deliberate research.

out_of_market_general_adults.factual_job: None. Product facts may be understandable but do not become relevant.
out_of_market_general_adults.hard_rule: No product feature converts lack of category need or authority into a purchase.

frequent_mismatch: status stages do not match transactional or reservation work
adjacent_small_business_without_fit.hard_rule: A feature list cannot substitute for an actual recurring client-information job.

low_volume_solo_service_providers.common_rejection: Manual email or a free form remains cheaper at low volume.

valued: Waiting on Client to Ready status
preference_variation: some prioritize a polished client experience
some require compatibility with an established process
active_independent_consultants.hard_rule: Do not infer an unstated integration or claim that every consultant needs all features.

preference_variation: Owners value economics and client experience
teams above two seats notice the plan limit
hard_questions: What additional seats cost is absent
micro_agencies.hard_rule: Two included users may be inadequate for a six-person agency and must not be framed as full-team coverage.

preference_variation: seasonal tax work values burst capacity
hard_questions: Security and compliance details are not supplied
bookkeeping_accounting_practices.hard_rule: The word secure link does not prove regulatory suitability.

preference_variation: design practices care about briefs and files
training teams care about CRM fit
other_professional_service_teams.hard_rule: Evaluate each profession's workflow separately; generic professional-service relevance is insufficient.

decisive_facts: incremental value over forms, CRM or custom databases
existing_workflow_tool_users.hard_rule: Recognition of useful features does not imply willingness to replace a functioning incumbent.

internal_champions_without_authority.hard_rule: Strong product preference may create an internal recommendation but must remain zero direct purchases.

procurement_controlled_service_teams.hard_rule: A product demo cannot clear an absent institutional requirement.
